_comment: agent_harness governance. Every key below is read by the engine (checked with tools/check_govern_keys.py against src/runtime/governance_config.cpp). Section comments say what each setting is FOR in this harness; README.md maps them to pipeline stages.
description: Governed multi-agent audit harness: planner -> worker (tools) -> verify -> critics -> judge
_comment_security: standard sandbox: no absolute paths, no fork/exec. NOT restricted: restricted removes FS_READ outright, and the harness reads its fixtures and workspace.
_comment_languages: The harness runs no polyglot code, so every registered language is blocked (HARD). This is what closes the CONTRA-013 gap at standard: an embedded <<python>> block reads paths that file.read() is denied (measured on b0a7c8d). NOTE: languages.allowed: [] would allow EVERYTHING (empty = unused), and CONTRA-013 still prints with this blocklist because it only consults sandbox_level.
_comment_capabilities: Shell off at the SANDBOX layer (the only containment that survives a renamed binary). Filesystem confined to the three directories the harness uses. functions: least privilege per function, intersected down the call stack; default grants nothing. Code written directly in main {} runs under default (the main block is not on the function stack, and no entry name targets it -- measured on both engines), so main only orchestrates and every effect goes through a named function below.
_comment_taint: Model output is untrusted. It may reach a file only through a function whose name starts with sanitize_. Agent output is tainted whenever taint tracking is on -- every send/propose/commit result, tool result and tool argument -- regardless of this sources list; the agent entries below document that rather than enable it. A dict holding ANY tainted value is tainted as a whole.
_comment_code_quality: Response secret/PII scanning is OFF unless enabled here. HARD: a response carrying a secret ends the run.
_comment_contracts: Structural guarantees on the harness code itself: ground truth must reach governance, and nothing reaches a file unsanitized.

run_step.description: Every worker step reports its ground-truth result to governance

write_report.description: Reports are sanitized before they are written

make_plan.description: Plans are selected from candidates and committed, never taken raw

_comment_agents: Each system_prompt opens with a unique AH-<ROLE> token: the local stub routes on it (run.sh --stub). allowed_actions is the per-role action matrix; tools are dual-gated (listed here AND registered in harness.naab).

planner.system_prompt: AH-PLANNER You plan code audit tasks. Given an audit task, return ONLY JSON: {"steps": [{"id": 1, "goal": "..."}]} with at most 4 steps. Each step goal names the files or the defect type the worker must audit.

worker.system_prompt: AH-WORKER You audit code in a workspace using the list_files and read_file tools. For each audit step, read the files, then return ONLY JSON: {"step": N, "files": ["name"], "defects": [{"file": "name", "line": N, "explanation": "one sentence"}]}. Report only defects you saw in the file content, with the exact line number.

critic.system_prompt: AH-CRITIC You review code audit drafts for accuracy and completeness. Return ONLY JSON: {"verdict": "APPROVED" or "REJECTED", "issues": ["..."]}. Reject an audit draft if any defect lacks a file and line.

judge.system_prompt: AH-JUDGE You give the final verdict on a code audit draft after the critics' review. Return ONLY JSON: {"verdict": "APPROVED" or "REJECTED", "reason": "one sentence"}.

_comment_dispatch: Run-level budgets: the hard stop ends the run before it can spend past these, whatever the script does.
_comment_exposure: max_unique_agents counts HANDLES, not configured roles: planner + worker + 2 critics + judge = 5. A sixth agent.create() is refused.
_comment_bsd: Behavioural sequence detection with the built-in patterns (tool exfiltration, env harvest, shell escape, cross-agent relay). Also feeds CDD: with this off, context drift scores nothing.
_comment_drift: Analyse every turn (roles are short-lived). Baseline window 3, not 5: a 2-turn judge would otherwise never leave calibration and its pass would never be a judgement.
_comment_circuit_breaker: Output admissibility quarantines low-coherence responses; the streak ends an agent that keeps producing them, but only on corroborated evidence. Step-up challenges at ELEVATED re-verify a drifting agent; two consecutive failures end it.
_comment_escalation: A repeated advisory becomes a HARD block (uncatchable). The count is per rule name across ALL agents (see tests/governance_v4/test_escalation_scope.sh).
_comment_health: Pulse verdict and health warnings. check_after_turns 5 (default 10): a stub run has 7 agent turns, and at 10 the per-turn health check never ran.
_comment_telemetry: Tamper-evident chain, replayable decision snapshots, and a full transcript (prompts, responses, tool calls) committed into the chain.
